question: Who among the following was primarily an exponent of Bharatanatyam dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arundale**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer of the Indian classical dance form of Bharatanatyam.
 
• She is considered the **revivalist** of Bharatanatyam from its original 'sadhir' style prevalent amongst the temple dancers, the Devadasis, thus giving it a new life and respectability.
 
• Rukmini Devi founded the **Kalakshetra Foundation** in Chennai in 1936, which is dedicated to the preservation of traditional values in Indian art, especially in the field of Bharatanatyam dance and music.
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in 1956 and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship** in 1967 for her contributions to the arts.
 
• Her efforts not only popularized Bharatanatyam but also helped in its recognition as a significant cultural heritage of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was an exponent of Odissi dance.
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is a leading exponent of Kathak dance.
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh** was a renowned Manipuri dancer and choreographer.
 
• Rukmini Devi's work in Bharatanatyam has had a lasting impact, ensuring the dance form's survival and growth in modern India.
